title: Oven Roasted Mexican Rhubarb Tacos
description: A cultured and molten Mexican dish featuring roasted rhubarb, perfect for a lazy Sunday, and friendly to those who avoid onion and garlic. This recipe combines the unique flavor of rhubarb with traditional Mexican spices.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the rhubarb with lime juice, olive oil, cumin, chili powder, and salt until the rhubarb is evenly coated.
Spread the rhubarb mixture out in a single layer on a baking sheet.
Roast the rhubarb in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until tender.
While the rhubarb is roasting, warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by spooning the roasted rhubarb onto a warmed tortilla, topping with fermented salsa, diced avocado, and chopped cilantro.
Serve the tacos immediately and enjoy.
Consider adding other toppings such as sour cream or shredded cheese to the tacos.
Leftover roasted rhubarb can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
